'''Kartill''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Glassferran]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] in the [[New Republic Defense Fleet/Legends|New Republic Navy]]. In [[5 ABY/Legends|5.5 ABY]], he participated in the [[Battle of Mindor]] as the [[Executive officer/Legends|executive officer]] aboard [[General/Legends|General]] [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian's]] [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruiser]], the [[Remember Alderaan (Star Cruiser)|''Remember Alderaan'']]. He was stationed on the bridge, where he analyzed many monitors with his three eyes.
